title: 2. Build and order the preference list

filters.title: Program search filters
filters.intro: Start with the region and program type. Additional filters are optional.
filters.emptyHint: Leave every filter empty to include all programs.
filters.more: More filters: school day, PIE, PACE, fees and other characteristics
filters.moreHint: Leave a filter empty when that characteristic is not essential for the family.

region.label: Program region
region.help: Choose a region to make the program list shorter. Already selected programs from other regions are kept in the list.

specialty.label: Specialized area
specialty.help: Leave empty to include all specialized areas.

gender.label: Gender composition
gender.help: Leave empty to include mixed, boys-only, and girls-only programs.

schoolDay.label: School day
schoolDay.help: Leave empty to include full-day, morning, and afternoon programs.

rurality.label: Rurality
rurality.help: Leave empty to include both urban and rural schools.

pie.label: PIE integration program
pie.help: Leave empty to include schools with and without PIE.

pace.label: PACE program
pace.help: Leave empty to include schools with and without PACE.

enrollmentFee.label: Enrollment fee
enrollmentFee.help: Leave empty to include every enrollment-fee category.

monthlyFee.label: Monthly fee
monthlyFee.help: Leave empty to include every monthly-fee category.

religious.label: Religious orientation
religious.help: Leave empty to include every orientation.

filters.keptOutside: Existing selected program(s) outside the current filters are also kept available: {n}.

search.title: Search and add programs
search.label: Search for a program
search.placeholder: Start typing the school name, commune, or program details.

current.title: Current preference list
current.empty: No program selected yet. Add the student's first wish above.
current.useBuilder: Use the builder below to enter the existing wish list directly.

order.strictHint: Enter programs in strict order. The first program is the highest-ranked choice, and the final chance of each lower option depends on not getting the options above it.
order.preferenceHint: Add the programs in the order the family genuinely prefers.
order.reorderHint: Use ↑ and ↓ to reorder the student's strict ranking.
order.howBody: Strict ranking means every program has a precise rank. Equivalence classes allow several programs to share the same preference group when the family sees them as tied.

notices.imputedTitle: Some selected programs use estimated historical calibration values.
notices.imputedShort: Less reliable estimate: at least one selected program uses mean-imputed 2024 calibration values.
notices.imputedBody: Complete historical observations were unavailable for at least one selected program, so the model uses an imputed 2024 value. Interpret those program-level estimates with additional caution.
notices.removed: Some programs in the current wish list are no longer available in the loaded data and were removed: {programs}
notices.recommendationsAdded: {n} recommended program(s) were added at the end of the list. Check priorities for the new programs, then analyze the list again.
notices.orderCount: The current equivalence classes generate {n} compatible strict order(s). The app will test them to see whether tied programs lead to the same or different predicted outcomes.
notices.addAtLeastOne: Add at least one program to unlock the analysis.
notices.duplicate: That program is already in the list.
notices.maxWishes: The list cannot hold more than {max} programs.
